knowledge_base: ATX headings (#) are preferred over setext (=== underlines) because they parse identically at every level.
A blank line before and after every heading prevents adjacent paragraphs from being absorbed into the heading.
Lists need a blank line above and below to avoid being joined into the previous paragraph in CommonMark.
Tables should align column separators by the longest cell so the source is readable even without a renderer.
Hard-wrap prose at 100 columns balances diff readability with not interrupting natural sentence flow.
Code fences must declare a language tag whenever known; this enables syntax highlighting and copy buttons.
Reference-style links keep paragraphs short; collect long URLs at the bottom of the section, not inline.
Trailing whitespace at end of line is a soft line break in CommonMark — remove unless intentional.
Emphasis style should be consistent: pick * for italic and ** for bold project-wide; never mix _ and *.
Front matter (YAML between --- markers) must be the very first content; even a blank line above breaks it.
